notes: ὁ συναντήσας is analysed under rule 90: the single relativizer who goes to the article and the verb to the participle.
Both articles before θεοῦ and ὑψίστου are unrepresented, the ASV writing no determiner for God Most High (rule 23).
ὑψίστου heads on High, the word carrying the ὑψ- lexeme, Most spelling only the superlative degree (rule 17).
